season.name: Summer
season.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movement.name: The Work
movement.line: Work is a gift before it is a burden.

days.t: The hands of the vigorous make rich
x: Poverty brings a man low: but the hands of the vigorous make rich.

days.t: The hand of chosen men shall rule
x: The hand of chosen men shall easily obtain rule; but the deceitful shall be for a prey.

days.t: The hands of the active are diligent
x: Every slothful man desires, but the hands of the active are diligent.

days.t: Where there is care, there is abundance
x: With every one [who is] careful there is abundance: but the pleasure-taking and indolent shall be in want.

days.t: The diligent man attends on kings
x: It is fit that an observant man and [one] diligent in his business should attend on kings, and not attend on slothful men.

days.t: Do not be slothful in zeal
x: not slothful in diligence, being fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
